# V-Lab inventory gaps (generated by scripts/vlab_review/inventory.ts, do not hand-edit)

## Why the counts differ
- Library = 248 unique block ids (248 entries). Component definitions (230) are help/LaTeX text only, so 23 library blocks lack one and 5 definitions have no library block.
- Equations (254 keys in `blockEquations`) cover 248 library blocks; 0 library blocks have none and 6 keys are orphans (aliases/legacy casings).
- DAEAssembler has 152 `case` labels in one `switch (blockType)`. It does not hold equations. It only allocates extra unknowns (branch currents/forces/fluxes, signal-output branches, internal states). Blocks without a case get no branch and no state, so their equation may only use across values.
- Symbols: 362 type keys in RawSymbolRenderer; 2 library blocks fall through to `UnknownSymbolGlyph` (see F-006).
